title: POST /game-api/s2s-api/v1.0/lobby/rooms/listActiveBans
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 by issuing `#ban list 1` over RCON while a ban was live: 200, 428 bytes. The entries are the server-side object the engine's OnlineBanListData class expands; the page limit of 25 is why RCON shows the list 25 entries at a time.

banRecord.description: One ban, exactly as the backend returned it: {"id":2430040,"targetType":"gid","targetName":"kolya_500","scope":"reforger:<roomId>:join","type":"gameServer","issuer":"room <roomId>","createdAt":...,"expiresAt":...}.

id.description: The backend's own ban id, not an identity.

targetType.description: gid = game identity, which is what an admin ban targets. Other target types are not observed.

targetName.description: The name at the time of the ban.

currentName.description: The name the backend knows now; equal to targetName in the capture.

scope.description: Where the ban applies. It pins the ban to one room - `reforger:<roomId>:join` - which is the machine-readable form of `the ban list belongs to one server`.

issuer.description: Who issued it: `room <roomId>`, i.e. the server itself.

expiresAt.description: createdAt + the requested banDuration (600 in the capture, 603 s after rounding). A permanent ban presumably has 0, which was not observed.
